decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal, by reason of the deficient number and nature of car parking spaces proposed and the intended means of vehicular access / egress would lead to an unsatisfactory development of the site, with inadequate car parking and access arrangements, and so would be likely to give rise to additional indiscriminate kerbside parking at and within the vicinity of the site and the A4 Red Route, which in turn would detrimental to the safety of both vehicles and pedestrians and would also be contrary to Policies T.2.5 of this Council's Adopted Unitary Development Plan and T.1.4 of the Revised Deposit UDP.

Condition : 2 - The proposal, by reason of its location within a predominantly residential area away from an identified town centre, would have a serious and adverse effect on the amenities enjoyed by residents of the area, by reason of noise, disturbance and general pedestrian and vehicular activity at and within the vicinity of the site, and would also be contrary to Policies Env.1.1 of this Council's Adopted Unitary Development Plan and H.3.4 and Env - B.1.1 of the Revised Deposit UDP
description: Change of use from residential (C3) to multiple occupation accommodation.
